purpose: Attribute the scarcity of current production ENTRY_ALLOWED and exact T+1 executable events without changing production semantics or tuning any rule.
research_questions: Is the observed low frequency structurally justified by independent safety/economic constraints?
Do multiple gates repeat the same target/entry geometry?
Do upstream Wave/Setup/confirmation stages or downstream target/RR stages dominate signal loss?
Is the recent daily-report observation distinguishable from long-run Development evidence?

population.candidate_universe_semantics: The frozen holdout roster is the fixed Development audit input. The live Candidate selector is not re-run and no post-outcome universe replacement is permitted.
population.time_half_definition: Within each market, EARLY/LATE is split at the midpoint of the sorted union of observed frozen session dates; this is descriptive only.

production_semantics.t_plus_1_source: existing exact next market-session OPEN executors

measurement_units.symbol_session: one valid frozen Quote row for one symbol and market session
measurement_units.candidate_lifecycle: one distinct causal lifecycle_index emitted by the existing SETUP_01 or SETUP_02 structural replay
measurement_units.setup_event: one candidate lifecycle start; it is not a new signal and does not imply confirmation
measurement_units.confirmed_event: one first-entry CONFIRMED replay event consumed by the existing Decision stream
measurement_units.decision_event: one confirmed event evaluated by the existing T-day Decision evaluator
measurement_units.exact_t_plus_1_executable_event: one existing ENTRY_ALLOWED plan classified EXECUTED using only the exact next session OPEN

first_fail.definition: The first terminal rejection in the existing production evaluation precedence. It is not a sum of all rejection reasons.

all_fail_overlap.definition: Research-only counterfactual predicates evaluated on the same T-day event, including downstream predicates that production precedence may not reach.
all_fail_overlap.unique_only_definition: A gate is unique-only when it is the sole applicable fail predicate for that confirmed event.
all_fail_overlap.overlap_definition: raw applicable occurrences minus unique-only occurrences; pairwise/triple intersections use the same event denominator.

rules: All other production rules remain fixed.
The source event, source Decision, source target candidates, and source execution are never mutated.
Target/RR/Entry Zone ablations may create a research-only counterfactual plan and re-use the exact T+1 OPEN executor semantics.
The confirmed Swing High ablation removes only CONFIRMED_SWING_HIGH provenance before nearest-first T1 selection, retaining any independent Fib provenance at the same price.
Confirmation ablation is reference-only signal-loss accounting and never creates ENTRY_ALLOWED or an executable event.
single_gate_ablation.confirmation_constraint: The four fixed pre-confirmation policies in PR #89 had eventual FAILED + never-CONFIRMED shares of approximately 59.9% to 76.4%; this is a safety boundary, not a production rule.

architecture_classification.quality_ranking_candidate: research classification only; no gate is automatically converted to a score
architecture_classification.redundant_derived: must be supported by this audit's overlap/ablation evidence; not assumed from names alone

recent_live_context.allowed_inputs: Only existing aggregate daily-report JSON artifacts if present under the explicit reports directory; no Sheets, holdings, secrets, or provider access.

forbidden: changing Entry Zone, confirmation, Fib, Swing, Wave, or depth bands
raw market-bar or event-dump artifact persistence
return, P&L, MFE, MAE, win-rate, expectancy, Sharpe, or optimized performance metrics
